_comment: v2 (2026-09-18): added takerFees per exchange, BRLA multi-chain pools, FX refs, updated threshold to 25 bps (above ~20 bps round-trip minimum on cheap venues). DEX token addresses verified against GeckoTerminal and PolygonScan/Solscan.

takerFees._comment: Default (non-VIP) taker fee in basis points per exchange, for stable/stable spot pairs. Round-trip = buy_fee + sell_fee. Sources: official fee pages, verified 2026-09-18.

binance.note: USDC pairs ~0.07125% standard; other stables 0.10%; recurring 0% USDC promos. Round-trip ~14 bps.

okx.note: Standard Lv1 0.10%; stable pairs excluded from tier-vol calc. Round-trip ~20 bps.

bybit.note: Flat non-VIP 0.10%; USDC discount only for VIP tiers. Round-trip ~20 bps.

kraken.note: Separate flat stable/FX schedule, no maker/taker split, 0.20% retail. Stable vol excluded from tier. Round-trip ~40 bps.

coinbase.note: US entry tier 0.90%; USDT/USDC lost stablepair discount May 2025. NOT viable for stable arb at default tier.

gate.note: Conservative; GT token gives discount; occasional zero-fee promos. Round-trip ~40 bps.

bitget.note: Standard 0.10%; 0% promo on USDC/USD launched Dec 2025 (check if active). Round-trip ~20 bps.

cexSpreads.label: USDC/USDT cross-venue
cexSpreads.note: Coinbase removed from rotation — 90 bps taker US tier makes it non-viable.

cexSpreads.label: USDC vs fiat USD
cexSpreads.note: Coinbase kept here only for USDC/USD fiat pair (0% maker / 0.001% taker vs USD — the exception).

cexSpreads.label: EURC/USDC (EUR stable, FX not peg=1)
cexSpreads.note: EUR/USD FX pair. Tracker fetches Coinbase USD/EUR rate; compare vs live EURUSD to spot dislocation. MiCA-gated in EEA.

dexPools.label: USDC/USDT core depth (Polygon)
dexPools.note: Deepest USD-stable on-chain pool. Verified live 2026-09-18: reserve ~$8.29M, 24h vol ~$24.5M. Absorbs $10k and $100k at low bps. Core-route depth anchor (research_v2 sec 2). Uniswap v4 pool id (64-char).
